Orenburg vs Sochi: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Russian Premier League matchday 14 fixture, as Orenburg hosts Sochi at the Gazovik Stadium. This is a crucial encounter for both teams, who are in the relegation zone and fighting desperately to stay in the top flight.

Kick-off: November 2, 2025, 09:00 UTC (12:00 MSK) Stadium: Gazovik Stadium, Orenburg Competition: Russian Premier League (RPL)

Orenburg vs Sochi: Match Preview

Orenburg, in 14th place, and Sochi, in 15th, come into this head-to-head clash as two of the league's struggling sides. For both teams, this is a 'six-pointer' where a victory could significantly boost their survival chances. Orenburg holds a massive advantage in head-to-head encounters, especially at home, and will look to use this to secure a positive result. Sochi, meanwhile, needs to break their poor run of form and pick up points against a direct competitor.

Team Form and Analysis

Orenburg

Despite their low league position, Orenburg has been more productive in attack compared to their opponent, scoring an average of 1.08 goals per match. However, the team's main issue is their defense, which concedes an average of 1.85 goals per game. Historically, Orenburg has dominated the rivalry with Sochi, winning 11 of their 15 head-to-head meetings.

Sochi

Sochi is having a disastrous season, sitting in the direct relegation zone. The team faces significant problems in both attack (0.85 goals per game) and defense, which is one of the worst in the league (2.31 goals conceded per game). Their only victory against Orenburg in the history of the fixture was a long time ago, and it will be extremely difficult for the 'Leopards' to expect success in this away match.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The statistics are entirely in favor of Orenburg. In 15 head-to-head meetings, Orenburg has secured 11 wins, Sochi has only one, and 3 matches have ended in a draw. At home, Orenburg gives Sochi virtually no chance.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Orenburg (4-3-3): Sysuev - Goglichidze, Prokhin, Adamov, Pérez - Bašić, Vera, Marin - Thompson, Gürlük, Vorobyov.
  • Sochi (5-4-1): Zabolotny - Makarchuk, Drkušić, Litvinov, Meshchaninov, Zaika - Yusupov, Kravtsov, Burmistrov, Djordjević - Kramarić.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Orenburg is the clear favorite in this 'relegation derby.' The home-field advantage and a dominant head-to-head record should help the hosts secure a vital victory.

  • Main Prediction: Orenburg to Win. Considering the head-to-head statistics and Sochi's defensive struggles, a home win appears to be the most likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams have the worst defensive records in the league, which promises a high-scoring game.

Hellas Verona vs Internazionale: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Italian Serie A matchday 10 fixture, as Hellas Verona hosts Inter Milan at the Stadio Marcantonio Bentegodi. This is a clash between a team from the relegation zone and a top contender for the league title.

Kick-off: November 2, 2025, 11:30 UTC (14:30 MSK) Stadium: Stadio Marcantonio Bentegodi, Verona Competition: Serie A

Hellas Verona vs Internazionale: Match Preview

Inter, currently 3rd in the table, travels to Verona aiming to continue their fight for the Scudetto. The Nerazzurri are in excellent form after a convincing 3-0 victory over Fiorentina and are looking to secure another win against their favorite opponent. Verona, in contrast, is in a deep crisis, sitting 18th in the relegation zone and without a single win in the current league season. For the hosts, this match against one of the league leaders will be an incredibly tough test.

Team Form and Analysis

Hellas Verona

Paolo Zanetti's team is in terrible form, having collected only 5 points from nine matches. Verona is facing serious problems in attack, having scored just 5 goals in the league. In the last round, the team lost 1-3 away to Como. The only consolation for the hosts is that they have lost only once in four home matches, often playing to a draw.

Inter Milan

The Milanese side approaches the match in high spirits. The victory over Fiorentina allowed them to overtake AC Milan in the table and get closer to the leaders. Inter has a historically strong record against Verona, winning 9 of the last 10 head-to-head meetings and remaining unbeaten against them for 28 Serie A matches. Last season, Inter thrashed Verona 5-0 at this very stadium.

Head-to-Head Statistics

Inter completely dominates this rivalry. The Nerazzurri have won 9 of the last 10 matches, with one game ending in a draw. The last two meetings ended in clean-sheet victories for Inter (1-0 and 5-0). Verona has failed to beat Inter in the league for 28 games.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Hellas Verona (3-5-2): Montipo - Bella-Kotchap, Nelsson, Valentini - Belghali, Serdar, Gagliardini, Bernede, Frese - Giovane, Orban.
  • Inter (3-5-2): Sommer - Akanji, de Vrij, Augusto - Dumfries, Barella, Çalhanoğlu, Sučić, Dimarco - Bonny, Martínez.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Inter is the undisputed favorite. Verona's dreadful form, attacking struggles, and Inter's dominance in head-to-head encounters leave the hosts with almost no chance.

  • Main Prediction: Inter to Win. Considering all factors, any outcome other than a victory for the visitors would be a massive surprise.
  • Goals Prediction: Inter to Win to Nil. Verona scores very few goals, and Inter has won the last two head-to-head matches with a clean sheet.

Join us for the live broadcast of the Spanish La Liga matchday 12 fixture, as Levante hosts Celta de Vigo at the Ciutat de València. This is a crucial encounter for both teams, who are in the bottom half of the table and aiming to secure points to move away from the relegation zone.

Kick-off: November 2, 2025, 13:00 UTC (16:00 MSK) Stadium: Ciutat de València, Valencia Competition: La Liga

Levante vs Celta de Vigo: Match Preview

Levante, having returned to the top flight, is relying on their home matches, where the team traditionally collects the majority of their points. For the Valencian side, this game against a direct competitor is an excellent opportunity to strengthen their position. Celta, on the other hand, has been struggling in away games, displaying inconsistent football. The team from Vigo will be looking to end their poor run on the road and take crucial points from Valencia.

Team Form and Analysis

Levante

'The Frogs' are known for their fighting spirit and organized play, especially on their home turf. The team focuses on a solid defense and quick counter-attacks. Despite a lack of star players, Levante compensates with dedication and tactical discipline. The main task for the hosts will be to neutralize the opponent's attacking line.

Celta de Vigo

The Galicians have a technically gifted squad, highlighted by the ageless Iago Aspas. However, the team lacks consistency, especially in defense. Celta concedes a lot in away matches, which is their main problem. Success in the upcoming game will depend on whether the team can find a balance between their attack and a reliable defensive performance.

Head-to-Head Statistics

Recent meetings between the teams have often been close and low-scoring. At Levante's home ground, matches are traditionally tight, and Celta rarely achieves easy victories.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Levante (4-4-2): Cárdenas - Son, Vezo, Pier, Clerc - de Frutos, Meler, Campaña, Morales - Martí, Gómez.
  • Celta de Vigo (4-1-3-2): Marchesín - Mallo, Aidoo, Núñez, Galán - Tapia - Pérez, Beltrán, Cervi - Aspas, Larsen.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Considering Levante's strength at home and Celta's struggles on the road, the hosts have a good chance of picking up points. A cautious game with few scoring opportunities is expected.

  • Main Prediction: Levante to Win or Draw (1X). The home-field advantage and Celta's unconvincing away form make this outcome the most likely.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Matches between these opponents at the Ciutat de València are rarely high-scoring.

Torino vs Pisa: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Italian Serie A match, as Torino hosts league newcomers Pisa at the Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino. This is a clash between an experienced Serie A side and an ambitious debutant fighting for survival.

Kick-off: November 2, 2025, 14:00 UTC (17:00 MSK) Stadium: Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino, Turin Competition: Serie A

Torino vs Pisa: Match Preview

Torino enters the match as the clear favorite. The Turin-based club, a solid mid-table team, relies on home games to collect points and aims to improve its position in the standings. A match against a newly promoted side at home is an excellent opportunity for 'Il Toro' to secure a confident victory. Pisa, having returned to the top flight after a long absence, will try to put up a fight and prove they can compete at the highest level, but the trip to Turin will be a major test for them.

Team Form and Analysis

Torino

The Turin team is known for its pragmatic and organized football. 'The Bulls' focus on a solid defense and quick transitions to attack. At home, Torino traditionally plays aggressively and concedes few goals. Key figures in the squad include striker Duván Zapata and midfield leader Nikola Vlašić. The hosts will aim to dominate from the first minute.

Pisa

For Pisa, every match in Serie A is a battle. The team compensates for a lack of quality with dedication and strict tactical discipline. Away against a strong opponent, Pisa is likely to adopt a deep defensive strategy, relying on set-pieces and rare counter-attacks. The main task for the visitors will be to contain Torino's powerful attack.

Head-to-Head Statistics

The teams have not met in Serie A in recent history, making this encounter particularly interesting. The lack of top-flight head-to-head meetings does not allow for conclusions based on previous games, but the difference in experience and class makes Torino the obvious favorite.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Torino (3-4-1-2): Milinković-Savić - Djidji, Buongiorno, Rodríguez - Bellanova, Ricci, Ilić, Lazaro - Vlašić - Zapata, Pellegri.
  • Pisa (4-4-2): Livaković - Calabresi, Caracciolo, Leverbe, Barbieri - Marin, Nagy, Touré, D'Alessandro - Bonazzoli, Moruțan.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Torino should handle the league newcomers at home without much trouble. The home-field advantage and the difference in player quality will be decisive.

  • Main Prediction: Torino to Win. 'The Bulls' are significantly superior to their opponent and will be highly motivated in front of their home fans.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Torino is known for its reliable defense, and Pisa is likely to play a defensive game, which is unlikely to lead to a high-scoring match.

Baltika vs Akhmat Grozny: Match Preview

Baltika comes into the match sitting in a high 5th place with 24 points and aims to solidify its position among the league leaders. The team has been playing confidently, especially in recent head-to-head meetings with Akhmat. Akhmat, positioned 9th with 16 points, has shown inconsistent results and travels to Kaliningrad with the goal of ending their horrific losing streak against Baltika.

Team Form and Analysis

Baltika (Kaliningrad)

The Kaliningrad side is in good form, with 3 wins in their last 6 matches. The team is strong at home, boasting a 50% win rate this season. But Baltika's main advantage is their incredible dominance in recent games against Akhmat. Furthermore, Baltika has a very solid defense, conceding an average of just 0.46 goals per game.

Akhmat (Grozny)

The team from Grozny faces significant problems in matches against Baltika. In the last four meetings, Akhmat has suffered four defeats with a combined score of 2-14. Akhmat's defense is their weak point, conceding an average of 1.46 goals per match, which is three times more than Baltika. Away from home, the team frequently draws, having tied half of their last six away games.

Head-to-Head Statistics

Recent head-to-head statistics are entirely in favor of Baltika. In the previous four matches, the Kaliningrad team has secured four crushing victories, scoring 14 goals and conceding only 2. The last meeting in April 2024 ended in a humiliating 1-7 defeat for Akhmat.

West Ham United vs Newcastle United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the English Premier League's 10th-round match, as West Ham United hosts Newcastle United at the London Stadium. This is a clash between two teams experiencing different phases of the season: West Ham is in crisis, while Newcastle has found good form.

Kick-off: November 2, 2025, 14:00 UTC (17:00 MSK) Stadium: London Stadium, London Competition: English Premier League (EPL)

West Ham United vs Newcastle United: Match Preview

West Ham enters the match in dreadful form, having suffered three consecutive league defeats and four straight losses at home. The team is desperately searching for its first win under new manager Nuno Espírito Santo. Newcastle, in contrast, has won their last three matches across all competitions and is aiming for their first away win of the season. The Magpies won their last meeting at the London Stadium and will look to capitalize on the Hammers' problems to secure points.

Team Form and Analysis

West Ham United

The Hammers are in a deep crisis, sitting 19th in the table. The team has lost seven of their last ten league matches. West Ham faces significant personnel issues, with Oliver Scarles, Dinos Mavropanos, and Niclas Füllkrug missing the match due to injury. Former Newcastle striker Callum Wilson is likely to start against his old club.

Newcastle United

Newcastle has gained momentum, winning their last three games, including victories over Fulham in the Premier League and Tottenham in the League Cup. Despite this, the team has yet to win on the road in the current league season. The visitors also have absences: Tino Livramento and Yoane Wissa are injured, while Lewis Hall's participation is in doubt.

Head-to-Head Statistics

In the last ten head-to-head meetings, Newcastle has the advantage with five wins, two losses, and three draws. The last match at this stadium ended in a 1-0 victory for the Magpies. In recent years, matches between these teams have often been high-scoring.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • West Ham (4-2-3-1): Areola; Wan-Bissaka, Todibo, Kilman, Diouf; Magassa, Soucek; Bowen, Paqueta, Summerville; Wilson.
  • Newcastle (4-3-3): Pope; Trippier, Thiaw, Botman, Burn; Guimaraes, Tonali, Joelinton; Murphy, Woltemade, Gordon.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although Newcastle has not won away, their current form is significantly better than that of a crisis-ridden West Ham, who have lost three consecutive matches.

  • Main Prediction: Newcastle to Win. The Magpies are in good form and should be able to defeat a West Ham side in a terrible state.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams have defensive issues, and their head-to-head encounters are often high-scoring.

Fiorentina vs Lecce: Match Preview

Fiorentina comes into the match in dreadful form, sitting 19th in the table without a single victory in the opening nine rounds. Stefano Pioli's side is having a disastrous start to the season, a stark contrast to last year's success when they finished sixth. Lecce, positioned 16th, is also facing significant struggles but is in a slightly better position, two points ahead of the hosts. Fiorentina

Despite this, the team is performing successfully in European competitions, which indicates a potential they have yet to unlock in the domestic league.

Lecce cannot boast good results either, having lost five of their nine matches. In the last round, the team lost 1-0 at home to Napoli. The visitors perform very poorly on the road, having lost three of their last four away games. Lecce's attack also looks unconvincing, scoring an average of just 0.78 goals per match.

In the last 24 head-to-head meetings, Fiorentina has the upper hand with 10 wins, 7 losses, and 7 draws. The 'Viola' are unbeaten against Lecce in six of their last seven matches (4 wins, 2 draws).

Deportivo Alavés vs Espanyol: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Spanish La Liga matchday 12 fixture, as Deportivo Alavés hosts Espanyol at the Mendizorrotza stadium. This is a clash between two teams showing different levels of football this season: Espanyol is competing for a European spot, while Alavés is in the lower half of the table.

Kick-off: November 2, 2025, 15:15 UTC (18:15 MSK) Stadium: Mendizorrotza, Vitoria-Gasteiz Competition: La Liga

Deportivo Alavés vs Espanyol: Match Preview

Espanyol approaches the match in excellent form, sitting in 5th place and having won their last two league games. The Catalans are displaying one of the best defensive performances in the league, with three clean sheets in their last four matches. Alavés, positioned 12th, has been highly inconsistent but is very strong at home, where they haven't lost in La Liga since mid-April (4 wins, 4 draws). Despite this, the head-to-head history is entirely in favor of Espanyol, who won the last two encounters, including the last one at Mendizorrotza.

Team Form and Analysis

Deportivo Alavés

The Basque side has shown unconvincing form in recent La Liga matches, winning only one of their last six. The team's main problem is their attack: Alavés has failed to score in three of their last five games. Matches involving Alavés this season have been the lowest-scoring in the league, with only 18 total goals in 10 games.

Espanyol

Espanyol is on a good run, having won their last three matches in all competitions. The team is playing excellent defense, which allows them to consistently pick up points. However, the Catalans are not as confident on the road, which could give Alavés a chance to get a result.

Real Betis vs Mallorca: Match Preview

Real Betis

FC Porto vs Sporting Braga: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of one of the central matches of the Portuguese Primeira Liga, 'O Clássico do Norte', as FC Porto hosts Sporting Braga at the Estádio do Dragão. This is a battle between two teams from the top of the table, which always promises high tension and an uncompromising fight.

Kick-off: November 2, 2025, 20:30 UTC (23:30 MSK) Stadium: Estádio do Dragão, Porto Competition: Primeira Liga

FC Porto vs Sporting Braga: Match Preview

Porto and Sporting Braga, sitting in 3rd and 4th place respectively, come into this head-to-head clash in excellent form. Porto is unbeaten in their last six matches and has won their last three games in a row. Braga is also on the rise, with three wins in their last four encounters. Despite this, the history of this fixture at the Dragão is entirely on the side of the 'Dragons,' who have not lost to Braga at home in the league for 20 years.

Team Form and Analysis

FC Porto

Sérgio Conceição's team is demonstrating a strong defensive performance, having not conceded a single goal in their last three matches. At home, Porto is traditionally strong, with victories in 8 of their last 10 home games. Their historical dominance over Braga at the Dragão makes them clear favorites, although recent meetings between the teams have been very tight.

Sporting Braga

The 'Archbishops' are playing high-scoring football, having found the net in 13 of their last 14 matches. The team has a successful away record, winning 8 of their last 10 away games. Nevertheless, Braga faces the challenge of breaking a 20-year 'curse' and defeating Porto at the Dragão in the league for the first time since 2005.

Head-to-Head Statistics

Porto dominates the head-to-head record, especially at home. In the last 69 matches, Porto has 47 wins, Braga has 10, and 12 games have ended in a draw. The last three matches between the teams have been low-scoring (two 1-0 wins for Porto and a 1-1 draw), in contrast to previous years when games were often rich in goals.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Porto (4-2-3-1): Costa - Mário, Pepe, Carmo, Wendell - Varela, Eustáquio - Pepê, Taremi, Galeno - Evanilson.
  • Sporting Braga (4-2-3-1): Matheus - Gomez, Fonte, Niakaté, Borja - Carvalho, Musrati - Djaló, Horta, Bruma - Banza.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite Braga's good form, Porto's historical dominance at the Dragão and their solid defensive play make the hosts the favorites.

  • Main Prediction: FC Porto to Win. The 'Dragons' have not lost to Braga at home in the league for 20 years and are in excellent form.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. The last three head-to-head meetings have been low-scoring, and Porto has kept a clean sheet in their last three matches.
